name: Tactec Meridian 6-Pocket Cargo Pant
description:
Straight-cut tactical pants in matte graphite or olive drab ripstop, with six external cargo pockets and four concealed interior ones. The fabric has a subtle grid texture from reinforced stress-point stitching. Sits mid-rise with a gusseted crotch for full range of motion.

Popular with security contractors, warehouse shift leads, and anyone who needs to carry a lot without looking like they're trying. Unassuming enough for a day job, practical enough for whatever happens after.
functionality: Six exterior cargo pockets, four concealed interior pockets, gusseted crotch, reinforced belt loops rated for duty belt weight
what_it_says: You're prepared, practical, and not interested in impressing anyone — just getting the job done.
story_hooks: A courier finds a sealed data chip tucked inside a pocket seam of a secondhand pair — it wasn't theirs.
A security guard's hidden pocket holds something their employer explicitly told them not to carry on shift.

physical_description.visual_profile: Utilitarian straight-leg silhouette with pronounced cargo architecture. Sits confidently at mid-rise, creating a balanced proportional line. The grid-textured ripstop catches light subtly, giving an industrial rather than tactical appearance. Designed to read as 'practical professional' rather than 'paramilitary.'
physical_description.fit: Straight through hip and thigh with gusseted crotch for unrestricted movement. Mid-rise waist. Tapered slightly at ankle without being slim-fit. Accommodates layered thermals or light armor inserts beneath without bunching.
physical_description.primary_material: Military-grade ripstop (synthetic poly-cotton blend), matte finish. Reinforced stress-point stitching creates a subtle grid topography across the surface.
physical_description.texture: Crisp hand-feel with visible grid pattern from reinforcement weaving. Slightly stiff when new, breaking in to supple over weeks of wear. Matte surface resists shine and light reflection.
physical_description.color_scheme: Matte graphite (cool gray) or olive drab. No contrasting trim. Stitching matches base color for seamless industrial aesthetic.
physical_description.closures: Heavy-duty friction-fit waistband with reinforced belt loops. Magnetic-snap fly (silent, reliable). No visible zippers on external pockets—concealed magnetic retention.
distinctive_features: Six external cargo pockets (two thigh, two knee-height, two hip/calf) with angled flap entries
Four concealed interior pockets distributed across waistband and upper thigh
Reinforced stress-point grid stitching creating texture and durability
Gusseted crotch panel for full range of motion
Subtle Tactec woven label at waistband (sans-serif, minimal branding)
Tool-loops on hip pockets and left thigh
Ripstop weave visible in angled light—signals practicality without announcing it
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3 functional. Affordable durability. Street-respectable without corpo polish. Not cheap-looking, not luxury.
physical_description.cultural_context: Security contractors, warehouse supervisors, independent couriers, off-shift emergency responders, anyone who needs carry capacity without advertising it. Worn by people who solve problems, not people who delegate them.
physical_description.condition_typical: Broken-in. Minor fraying at pocket seams. Possible reinforced patches at high-stress points. Faded graphite or weathered olive from UV exposure and wash cycles. Authenticity comes from earned wear, not styled distressing.
